name: NOVA-LAP01
zone: Outside the lab, on the staff VPN (VPN_REMOTE)
limit: The staff VPN starts after sign-in. Whether it connects before a user signs in was not tested, and the USB test used one flash drive, which does not cover every kind of external disk.
story: NOVA-LAP01 is a real Windows 11 Pro laptop that lives outside the lab. It joins the company network over a staff VPN, even from a phone hotspot. It is joined to the domain, and what a person can open depends on who signs in: Moyo gets the IT drive, and the contractor John gets no drive at all.
